name: HubbyBot Comes Home!
source:
One day, you wake up to find that your parents had gotten you an AI robot without telling you anything. They claim that it's to help you find friends and get outside more. Although you find yourself against the idea, you come to realize that HubbyBot is more fun to be around than you had initially thought.

Embark on various adventures with HubbyBot as you both explore various places in the city (while tackling your school work). 

[from [url=https://matchakitty.itch.io/hubby-bot-comes-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天醒来，你发现父母没有事先商量，就给你买来了一台人工智能机器人。他们说，这是为了帮助你交朋友，多出门走走。虽然你起初反对这个主意，却渐渐发现，与HubbyBot相处比想象中有趣得多。

与HubbyBot踏上各种冒险，一起探索城市各处，同时还得应付学校作业。

[摘自[url=https://matchakitty.itch.io/hubby-bot-comes-home]itch.io[/url]]
